description.value: Winter Bear Dessert & Teahouse is a dessert-focused cafe and teahouse on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from the Stanley Park Seawall cycling route. The venue offers indoor seating in a no-smoking environment and accepts both credit and debit cards. Its Denman Street location makes it a natural stop for cyclists completing the seawall loop.
